title: Named-root lapse retirement can remove a root after a restart, before its idle holder rebinds its claim
outcome: Named-root lapse retirement can remove a root after a restart, before its idle holder rebinds its claim
acceptance: After a TermAl restart, the automatic pass does not retire a root for a claim lapse of more than two hours while the root's naming session is present and has not yet rebound since the restart, unless Engram's claim block shows a holder that is not that session's actor; a regression test covers a restart followed by a pass before the idle naming session's first turn
